contract: Chosen horizontal LTR spatial-reading policy, not universal semantic ground truth. For retain cases, the local pair repair must preserve raw parser line order. Existing global ordering is recorded separately.

positive_reverse.semantic_status: Author-chosen ALPHA then BETA; stream emits BETA first; no tags

mixed_directions.semantic_status: Unshaped mixed Latin/Hebrew glyphs; no linguistically authoritative bidi reading oracle

mixed_within_word.semantic_status: Mixed strong bidi classes; deliberately no semantic reading oracle

superscript.semantic_status: Raised smaller BETA, not ordinary baseline word pair

paired_alphabetic_near.semantic_status: Author-declared paired labels meet the spatial contract but remain semantically ambiguous; acceptance does not prove prose

paired_alphabetic_wider.semantic_status: Author-declared labels just outside the maximum word-gap gate

paired_alphabetic_columns.semantic_status: Wide paired labels; existing global column rules may reorder, which is distinct from the new local repair

unit_contract: Inject NaN and both infinities into every component of block/line/span bbox and span origin on otherwise qualifying reversed pairs. Local repair must return the original block without reordering. These synthetic dictionary probes do not claim that such coordinates occur in a real parser output.
